findings.summary: The new README sentence says `sync` neither refreshes nor retracts frozen `odd/` and `session/` pages. Sync does retract them when their observation is soft-deleted or superseded: `Propagate` patches the page status to archived or superseded without checking eligibility. The claim holds for refreshing but not for retracting.
evidence: propagate.go:112-155 eachPatchTarget walks ObservationsIncludingDeleted, finds each observation promoted page, and calls decidePatch. It never calls Eligible.
propagate.go:23-34 documents that Propagate rewrites status:/related: on already-promoted pages whose observation was soft-deleted or superseded.
project_sync.go:54 shows Propagate runs as part of the project sync.
doctor_eligibility.go:86-89 skips a page whose observation is no longer live, so deleted-observation pages are never named.
eligible.go: the exclusion map includes odd and session; curatedTopicKey strips the goal prefix before testing the first segment.
eligible_test.go:87-95 goal-prefixed rows match that logic.
sync.go decidePromotion skips ineligible observations with no write; sync_cards.go:108 the same for memorycard.
